units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 16:10">Targ. Num. XVI, 10</cite> <he>כ׳ רבתא</he> high-priesthood; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 40:15">Targ. O. Ex. XL, 15</cite> <he>כְּהוּנַת</he> ed. Berl. (ed. <cite ref="K00167"><he>כַּהֲנוּת</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:5:3">Y. Keth. I, 25ᶜ</cite> <he>סליקא לכ׳</he> she rose to priesthood (as a priest’s wife); <he>נחיתא מן כ׳</he> went down from priesthood (ceased to enjoy priestly privileges as a priest’s wife).
